cells.gaps: No source found says any transfer goes without ARTCI's prior authorisation, or that ARTCI has published a list, model terms or a general authorisation.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): Decree 2015-79 requires ARTCI's prior authorisation for a transfer even to a country with equal protection, and names no route without it [CIV-001]. That answers question 1 yes and question 2 closed, so the stage is 2.
